map.洁净空气输出比率（m³/h），越大单位时间净化能力越强；分颗粒与气态 CADR，: The clean air delivery rate (m³/h) — the larger it is, the stronger the purification per unit time; there are separate particulate and gaseous CADR values, and they often differ.

map.适用面积公式准吗？: Is the Applicable Area Formula Accurate?
map.：卧室 20 m²、层高 2.8 m、目标约 5 次/h：需 CADR≈20×2: : for a 20 m² bedroom with a 2.8 m ceiling and a target of about 5 air changes per hour, CADR≈20×2.8×5=280 m³/h is required, so choose a model with a rated CADR≥300 to leave margin. Note: heavy smoking or pollen pollution needs a higher CADR or the high setting.
